text.title: FreshDrop, product team, August–September 2026
text.problem_0: Groceries take too long to order
text.problem_1: Slots are hard to pick after work
text.problem_2: No time for a weekly shop
text.problem_3: Weekly shop from a saved list
text.assumptions: Families pay 10% more for a fixed slot and order at least 3 times a month
text.riskiest: Families will commit to a fixed weekly slot before they pay for it
text.method: 12 interviews and a landing page with weekly box pre-orders
text.criterion: At least 5% of landing visitors pre-order before we build
text.results: Landing: 500 visits, 31 pre-orders (6.2%); 9 of 12 interviewees said yes
text.invalidated: No: the weekly box assumption held, so no pivot
text.validated: ✓ Weekly box goes to build; next step is a 2-district pilot from 1 November
